item.title: SQLite: The Database That's Everywhere
item.description: A two-host deep dive into SQLite: its origin on a Navy destroyer project, how it works inside (VDBE bytecode, B-trees, the pager), rollback journals vs WAL, dynamic typing and STRICT tables, where it's used, when to choose it over Postgres, its modern second life with Litestream, libSQL and the edge, and practical tips.
